# Netra Ecosystem

> Netra Ecosystem, also called Netra Eco, is the home of Netra Android apps. Use the official app pages for requirements, download information and privacy policies. Planned features are not released features.

## Official website
- [Netra Ecosystem](https://prayagi-store-and-services.github.io/netra-eco/): app directory, current catalogue, release information and separate future plans. GitHub Pages is the primary website.

## App details
- [Netra Battery Sentinel Pro](https://prayagi-store-and-services.github.io/netra-eco/app/bspn/)
- [Netra Charge](https://prayagi-store-and-services.github.io/netra-eco/app/charge/)
- [Netra Ecosystem](https://prayagi-store-and-services.github.io/netra-eco/app/eco/)
- [Netra Human Safety](https://prayagi-store-and-services.github.io/netra-eco/app/hub/)
- [Netra KBC](https://prayagi-store-and-services.github.io/netra-eco/app/kbc/)
- [Netra Player](https://prayagi-store-and-services.github.io/netra-eco/app/player/)
- [Netra Privacy Guard](https://prayagi-store-and-services.github.io/netra-eco/app/privacy/)
- [Netra Trikaal](https://prayagi-store-and-services.github.io/netra-eco/app/trikaal/)

## Privacy and data
- [Legal and data](https://prayagi-store-and-services.github.io/netra-eco/legal/): app privacy policies and data safety information.

## Reading this directory
Release details and availability can change. Consult each app page and its linked release record for current status. Missing live values are Unavailable. This file is a navigation aid, not a guarantee of search indexing, AI citations, app availability or product capabilities.
